main_text.l: lon sal, Exercèbor : & Getlot, Exercitatus] Labor nobis Toile ; laborare, totolle : Saxon. etiam studia, quaestus, conatus, vylunzei adnitens, vylzeno.
Wertbe, Itineribus : supra Gèvert-the] Ire, Iter facere, Sax. papan; de quo supra in Fàrlitboh.
Alta, Olla. Siburgi hodie, ulengasse, Platea Figulorum.
Unera, Reverentia : & unefoh, pudore] Revereri, Sax. unapian; ignominia unapé : ab an, Teut. hodie on, absque, & ane, honor, decus : quasi sine honore, decore.
Underthudta, Subjecta : & Underthudiga, Subditi. Nos unoerdaeotcb] Subditi, Sax. unoepheo, ab eorum undep, (quod nobis manifit) subtus, & Seod, populus, gens.
Unsuoti, Molesti] Quasi unsuoet, i.e. haud suaves.
Un, Ufque : & untes, donec : & unt, idem] Nobis hodie unttl.
